verdict.rationale: llamafile documents a CLI argument reference and command-line flags such as --cli and --server (docs-9, docs-6, probe-4). It also ships GPU acceleration across Metal, NVIDIA, AMD and Vulkan (docs-12), and bundles overridable default arguments (docs-8), so CLI-driven model configuration is plausible. However, no cited evidence shows a GPU-layer offload flag or a context-length flag, and one user could not find how to shift processing to the GPU (comm-13), which suggests offload control is not obvious. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of GPU offload flags (e.g. layer count), explicit documentation of a context-length flag, and hands-on corroboration of tuning either from the command line.
